name: Run The Race
overview: Scripture uses the metaphor of running a race to describe the Christian life as a disciplined, persevering pursuit of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus. Believers are encouraged to lay aside sin and every hindrance, running with patience and endurance while looking to Jesus, the author and finisher of faith, who endured the cross for the joy set before Him. Strength is renewed by waiting on the Lord, enabling believers to run without growing weary or faint, pressing forward toward the prize of their heavenly calling.
